headline: Madrid Cuts IBI to Legal Minimum of 0.4% and Announces Savings of 31.2 Million for 2027
summary: Madrid will cut the IBI property tax to the legal minimum of 0.4%, benefiting 2.27 million receipts and projected to save 31.2 million in 2027. The waste fee keeps an average charge of 143 euros.
why: Municipal property taxes affect homeowner costs and the value of residential real estate. Madrid is Spain's capital and a major economic center.
